entries.5c4fd2d77e19735d: It states that it will pursue brand enhancement aimed at increasing the value of “Genpin,” its core business, and will work toward re-growth and improved profitability based on this. Going forward, it states that it will polish the value of “Genpin” and expand into torafugu and other ingredients, increase its share in the torafugu dish industry and improve the profitability of each store, and push forward the expansion of franchises across Japan and overseas.

entries.65bde1db1b68a510: The torafugu dish industry is greatly affected by economic trends, torafugu prices and inbound tourists. Because torafugu is a high-end ingredient, the company considers that the number of customers and average spending per customer are determined by consumer willingness to spend.
entries.65f025d3a8998052: It operates its core business, the torafugu specialty restaurant “Genpin,” through directly operated stores and franchises. Its competitive strength is offering ingredients of differentiated quality and safety at lower prices, through technology development related to ingredients and strengthened procurement capabilities. It also performs bulk processing at the central kitchen at its head office.
entries.69b2c8c2d62f58f0: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥123 million, down 67.3% year on year. The main factors were higher raw material costs and increases in expenses, including personnel costs.
entries.704f93c470b3156e: This is the only business of the company's group (a single segment), operating the specialty Torafugu restaurant 'Genpin' through company-owned stores and franchises. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,272 million. As of March 31, 2026, there were 41 company-owned stores and 20 franchise stores in Japan, and there are also stores in Singapore. Its headquarters in Matsubara, Osaka Prefecture has the West Japan Logistics Center, equipped with a central kitchen, which processes ingredients and supplies them to stores. The consolidated subsidiaries are two companies: Kanmonkai (Shanghai) Trading Co., Ltd., which handles ingredient procurement and other operations in China, and KANMONKAI-SG PTE. LTD., which operates 'Genpin' in Singapore.
